draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.70, the 11th-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 2nd of 28 at WR. He went 25th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: DeSean Jackson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,318 receiving yards in 2018, 5th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 8 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 90 career games and 72 starts over 7 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 9 in 2020. Strengths in 2025: receiving td 5 (76th percentile). Versus the typical Year-7 wide receiver who played: 587 receiving yards against a median of 321, above the norm.
